# REVIEW / RETRO  
Implementation Process:  
I implemented a shared AppLogic interface so both controller implementations conform to the same contract. I then implemented two logic layers.

Local logic in logic.py that calls user\_service directly.  
Alternate logic in logic\_api.py that makes HTTP requests to the deployed User API for login, profile update, and list users operations.  
This keeps the app modular and allows switching controller strategy without changing the UI contract. This is just better.

# DISCUSSION  
The main challenge was ensuring the alternate controller was interface compatible while using HTTP and token based auth instead of direct service calls. Fixed by implementing identical method signatures and mapping API responses to shared User models.
